status_meaning: No event data has been fetched. SEC endpoint facts below come from EDGAR documentation knowledge and are NOT_PROBED in this session. C-E0 verifies them; C-E1 freezes a v1 file with its own checksum before the first event statistic.
principles: No AI, no ML, no free-text sentiment. An event class is decided by form type and 8-K item number only.
A direction is assigned only when the form or item itself implies it. Everything else is UNKNOWN and is never promoted to POSITIVE.
Direction for cohort E comes from the price response, never from the filing content.

source.primary: SEC EDGAR submissions JSON per CIK (filings: accessionNumber, form, filingDate, acceptanceDateTime, items) and nightly bulk submissions archive
source.fallback: EDGAR full-index/daily-index (form, CIK, filing date; no acceptance time -> only usable with the conservative next-session rule)
source.ticker_to_cik: cik field of the Massive CS reference snapshots already cached for C (latest snapshot with as_of <= D); SEC company_tickers.json is current-only and is not used for history
source.history: EDGAR electronic filings cover the whole 2024-09..2026-09 price window; event depth is not the binding constraint, price depth (Massive Basic 2y) is

pit.event_session: first XNYS session whose 16:00 ET close is later than available_at
pit.usable_for_signal_D: event_session in [D-1, D] (available_at < 16:00 ET of D)
pit.pending: available_at in [16:00 ET of D, signal time] -> E_PENDING: not an event for D, and the candidate is removed from the no-event cohort too (counted)
pit.amendments: 8-K/A and other /A forms never create a new event date; an /A with no original in range is ignored (counted)
pit.unknown_cik: ticker-date without a CIK -> EVENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN, excluded from E, EM and M-no-event, counted
pit.mutation_audit: shifting every available_at by +1 session must change cohort membership only for the affected dates; any event with available_at after the signal time of D found in D's cohort is a PIT violation

EARNINGS_RELEASE.why: no consensus source (Massive Benzinga earnings 403); 10-Q XBRL arrives weeks later; EX-99.1 press releases are not XBRL

ITEM_1_01_AGREEMENT.why: same item covers customer contracts, credit agreements, ATM sales agreements and merger agreements; MATERIAL_CONTRACT vs MATERIAL_AGREEMENT cannot be split without reading text

MA_TARGET_PIN.source: SC 14D9, SC TO-T (subject company), PREM14A, DEFM14A
MA_TARGET_PIN.why: a target's price converges to the deal price; momentum there is not drift
MA_TARGET_PIN.v1: EXCLUSION filter (removed from every cohort, counted)

EQUITY_DILUTION.why: priced offering, shelf takedown (incl. ATM) or unregistered equity sale

DISTRESS.why: bankruptcy, delisting notice, non-reliance on prior financials

EXCLUDED.424B2: dominated by bank structured notes, not issuer dilution
EXCLUDED.424B3: resale and merger prospectuses, direction not structural
EXCLUDED.CONVERTIBLE_FINANCING: needs text to separate from other 8-K 1.01/2.03 debt
EXCLUDED.GOING_CONCERN: 10-K/10-Q text; an XBRL flag is unverified (check in C-E0)
EXCLUDED.REGULATORY_FDA_ETC: not an SEC-structured item; openFDA lacks announcement timestamps and sponsor-ticker mapping
EXCLUDED.NEWS: Massive news is unstructured; insights are AI-derived and banned

PROPOSED_NOT_IN_V1.INSIDER_PURCHASE: Form 4 XML transaction code P; structurally positive but outside the requested list, needs its own declaration

cohorts.base_variant: C-M0 (V1 thresholds unchanged; C-M1's RS conditions added no information in V1)
cohorts.M_only: C-M0 candidates with no usable event, no E_PENDING, known CIK
cohorts.EM: C-M0 candidates with a usable event in EARNINGS_RELEASE, ITEM_1_01_AGREEMENT or ACQUISITION_COMPLETED, and no EQUITY_DILUTION/DISTRESS event
cohorts.E: eligible ticker-dates with a usable event of those classes and return_1d >= 0.03 on D (V1 threshold, no volume or 5D condition)
cohorts.risk: any candidate with EQUITY_DILUTION or DISTRESS in [D-20, D] reported separately
cohorts.all_cohorts: MA_TARGET_PIN removed; same matching cells, labels and bootstrap as V1

hypotheses_to_freeze_at_c_e1.H1: EM close_10 excess over matched controls > 0
hypotheses_to_freeze_at_c_e1.note: No cohort is assumed best. Thresholds, CI levels and gate are frozen in c-v2c v1 before the first event fetch.
